# EVM interest rate models and utilization kinks — concept pack (small)

> Source-anchored research for EVM interest rate models and utilization kinks. Run status: COMPLETED.

<!-- generated by llms-concept-abstractor v1.4.1 · generated 2026-11-06 · budgeted to ≈8000 tokens; the full catalogue is llms-full.txt -->

## How it works

- [statement] Gauntlet's curve method applies only to assets with substantial usage data (new assets get a default curve or a comparable live asset) and assumes users are at least partly rate-elastic and that elasticity changes slowly. Its heuristics raise Slope2 and lower the optimal point when whale dominance is high or when supply is large relative to average daily volume or market cap, and lower Slope2 when users are overly sensitive to utilization changes around the optimal point. (low confidence) — https://gauntlet.xyz/resources/methodology-interest-rate-curves

## Facts and statements

- [statement] Euler's vault kit offers IRMLinearKink (utilization = borrows/(cash+borrows) as a uint32; rate = baseRate + util x slope1 up to the kink, then plus (util - kink) x slope2; all four parameters immutable) and IRMAdaptiveCurve, a port of Morpho's adaptive curve that returns per-second rates scaled to RAY for the EVK. (medium confidence) — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/euler-xyz/euler-vault-kit/master/src/InterestRateModels/IRMLinearKink.sol · keywords: EVM interest rate models and utilization kinks · also: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/euler-xyz/evk-periphery/master/src/IRM/IRMAdaptiveCurve.sol
